g.text: Sequence Diagram - BCK10 Define a Predefined Pizza Composition
SELECT Product and composition FOR UPDATE
[Product does not exist or is not an eligible Sellable Product]
Read representative/component roles, type rules and eligible sizes
validate component eligibility, type bounds and size coverage
UPDATE Product and replace composition items
BCK05 creates and owns the Sellable Product first. BCK10 sets its default
composition on that same Product using its ProductId; it creates no second
aggregate or identifier. Each selected component occurs once (quantity 1).
BCK10 rejects a component list containing the representative ProductId before
opening the transaction. The configuration must cover at least one active size.
BCK08 owns size-specific consumption. This flow does not inspect stock.
